approaches.name: Retoken, reuse, one new router
approaches.summary: Keep every existing component and endpoint. Port aix-payroll-compare's design tokens (--bg/--s1..s3/--acc/--ok/--warn/--err, shadows, radius) into web/app/globals.css mapped onto the existing shadcn variables, force dark as the default, add a /dashboard page composed of KpiCard + recharts over the reports and llm_usage endpoints plus one new GET /dashboard aggregate, restyle LlmChat's four small parts (composer box, user bubble, start cards) to payroll-compare's classes, add a `rules` PromptKey with a `config.set` action that PUTs matching.* keys, and a POST /items/submit multipart router that calls the existing `ingest()` with SourceKind.MANUAL so the file becomes an ordinary work item.
approaches.how:
1. globals.css: replace :root/.dark oklch greys with payroll-compare's token block (light+dark, same shadcn mapping); ThemeProvider defaultTheme="dark"; app-shell header/sidebar pick up the new vars automatically. No per-page CSS.
2. api: new routers/dashboard.py (auto-discovered) returning {receipts_matched, applied_by_currency, per-model {calls, cost_usd, outcome ok%}, adjudicator_agreement (adjudication.disagreements empty / total), autofix_rate} from ReportQueryRepository + LlmUsageRepository.daily(group_by=MODEL) + one new AdjudicationRepository count. web: app/(shell)/dashboard/page.tsx = KpiCard grid + 2 recharts (bar by currency, line cost/day), nav entry.
3. chat: PromptKey.RULES in prompts.py with the matching.* config snapshot as its context; action id `config.set` whose onAction server-action calls PUT /config/{key}; LlmChat composer/message-list/suggestions get payroll-compare's BOX_CLASS/start-card classes; variant "panel" rendered on /rules page.
4. intake: routers/submit.py POST /items/submit (multipart, ≤N files, image/pdf allowlist) → ingest(..., source_kind=MANUAL, priority=PRIORITY_LIVE); returns item ids; UI dialog on /exceptions links to /items/[id] where artifact-viewer + history + adjudication already show the 'in-depth review' result.
5. exceptions: no structural change; the retheme restyles it. Default filter already hides applied items (list is exceptions-only).
evidence: web/app/globals.css:57-136 (neutral oklch tokens; same shadcn var names payroll-compare maps onto)
D:/AIX-Payroll-Compare/webapp/src/app/globals.css:100-205 (token block --bg/--s1/--acc/--ok plus shadcn mapping, light and dark)
web/components/common/llm-chat.tsx:32-44 (props: context, systemPromptKey, actions, onAction, variant)
api/src/cashapp/pollers/intake/ingest.py:52-62 (ingest(uow_factory, object_store, artifact, source_kind=...) reusable by any caller)
api/src/cashapp/domain/artifacts.py:14-24 (IncomingArtifact fields a multipart upload fills)
api/src/cashapp/api/routers/items.py:64-99 (GET parts streams the stored image back for the review view)
web/app/(shell)/exceptions/page.tsx:126-140 (page already exceptions-only, filter bar in place)
risks: Tailwind utility names like border-line-strong / bg-surface-2 used in payroll-compare need @theme inline aliases in globals.css or must be translated to border-border / bg-muted; mixing both would duplicate tokens.

config.set from chat touches admin-only keys; the action handler must go through the normal PUT with the user's token so the API enforces CONFIG_WRITE, and the UI must surface the 409 on expected_version mismatch.
'Receipts matched' has no single column; counting ReceiptReservation/MatchCandidate.chosen vs completions needs one agreed definition or the KPI will drift from the daily summary.
Multipart upload size/type limits and virus-free assumption are new attack surface; must reuse normalise()'s sniffing and cap body size at the proxy route as well.
In-depth review = the normal pipeline; if Jonathan expected a separate heavier read (higher effort), that is a follow-up setting (priority or effort override on MANUAL items), not in this slice.

approaches.name: Dashboard-as-report tab, chat sheet everywhere
approaches.summary: Smaller still: no new pages. Add a 'Progress' tab to the existing /reports page fed by the existing daily-summary and llm-usage endpoints (no new API), retheme via tokens as in approach 1, put the LlmChat sheet in the app-shell header so the `rules` chat is reachable from any screen, and ship image submission as a drop-zone in the exception sheet that posts to the same new POST /items/submit.
approaches.how:
1. Same globals.css token port + defaultTheme dark.
2. web/components/reports/progress-view.tsx: calls GET /reports/daily-summary (applied_by_currency, auto_applied_pct) and GET /llm-usage/daily?group_by=model; adjudicator agreement omitted until an endpoint exists (shown as 'n/a').
3. app-shell.tsx header: <LlmChat variant="sheet" systemPromptKey={pageKey} …/>, key derived from pathname; `rules` key + config.set action as in approach 1.
4. POST /items/submit router via ingest(); drop-zone component in components/common used by the exception sheet and the flow page empty state.
evidence: web/components/shell/app-shell.tsx:98-109 (header slot for a global Ask sheet)
risks: Model efficiency without adjudicator agreement and per-model accuracy misses two of the four named metrics; the acceptance criterion reads as inferred but is explicit.
A header-level chat whose context changes with the route must reset state on navigation or it will answer about the previous page.
A dashboard buried under /reports is less visible than Jonathan's 'primarily report on progress' asks; nav entry probably wanted anyway.

approaches.name: Port payroll-compare chat wholesale
approaches.summary: Replace components/common/llm-chat with the assistant-ui based chat feature from AIX-Payroll-Compare (ChatPanel, Composer, thread, plugins) for pixel-identical styling, keep theme/dashboard/submission as in approach 1.
approaches.how:
1. Add @assistant-ui/react, react-markdown deps; copy features/chat/ui/{composer,thread,activity} and adapt the runtime adapter to the existing SSE frames (token/action/done/stream-error).
2. Map payroll-compare plugin slots to CashApp props (context chips = ChatContextRef, actions = proposals).
3. Rest as approach 1.
evidence: web/components/common/llm-chat/use-chat.ts, chat-reducer.ts (working SSE client that would be thrown away)
web/components/common/llm-chat/chat-schemas.ts:5-6 (stream proxy allow-list tied to the current protocol)
risks: Violates KISS: the brief wants the look, not the plugin system, side panel, dictation, proposals or conversation persistence.
assistant-ui runtime expects the Vercel AI SDK stream shape; adapting to the existing sse_starlette frames is a bespoke adapter plus a second client to maintain.
Second chat implementation during the switch breaks the 'one chat component' rule until the old one is deleted.
